title: Neural Bayesian Networks for Modular and Scalable Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.16902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian Networks (BNs) are established tools for letting agents reason under uncertainty in sequential decision-making. They split a joint distribution into local conditional mechanisms arranged on a directed acyclic graph, which makes them modular, interpretable, and ready to perform probabilistic inference. Their classical formulation, however, has limitations in both expressiveness and scale: each conditional is usually stored as a table or a linear-Gaussian form, and inference evaluates the graph one node and one query at a time.   In this paper we introduce Neural Bayesian Networks (NBNs), in which each conditional is a differentiable, tensor-valued mechanism, while the graph and its factorization are unchanged. NBNs retain the modularity and local mechanisms of BNs, can represent any learnable conditional distribution, and run natively on GPUs. We also release NBN, a PyTorch-based library for learning and inference in NBNs, togeth

translated_title: 神经贝叶斯网络：面向模块化与可扩展的不确定性决策
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯网络是让智能体在序贯决策中进行不确定性推理的成熟工具。它们将联合分布分解为排列在有向无环图上的局部条件机制，这使其具有模块化、可解释性，并能够执行概率推断。然而，其经典表述在表达能力和规模上均存在局限：每个条件分布通常以表格或线性高斯形式存储，而推断则是一次评估图中一个节点和一个查询。在本文中，我们提出了神经贝叶斯网络，其中每个条件是一个可微分的、张量形式的机制，而图结构及其分解保持不变。NBN保留了贝叶斯网络的模块化和局部机制，能够表示任意可学习的条件分布，并可在GPU上原生运行。我们还发布了NBN，一个基于PyTorch的NBN学习与推断库……
tldr: 提出神经贝叶斯网络，将贝叶斯网络的条件分布替换为可微分的张量机制，在保留模块化与可解释性的同时，实现任意条件分布的表示以及GPU上的高效可扩展推断。
en_tdlr: Proposes Neural Bayesian Networks (NBNs), which replace Bayesian network conditionals with differentiable tensor-valued mechanisms, retaining modularity and interpretability while enabling representation of arbitrary learnable conditionals and scalable GPU-based inference.
